title: Stay on Camera
intro: A caller says you are part of a money investigation, and you must stay on camera.
They are calm, official, and very patient. That is the trick.
Pick your replies and sniff each message.

notify.text: Stay on camera. This is a legal matter…

banner: Video call · you do not follow this account

msg: A wallet linked to your name was

msg.text: Stay on camera, do not hang up.

replies.text: What do I have to do?
I will hang up and call the police myself

msg.text: move your coins to the court-appointed wallet
Tell nobody, it would obstruct justice.

replies.text: Why do I need to send coins to prove anything?

msg.text: Hang up and a warrant will be issued today.

replies.text: No court asks for coins. Hanging up and reporting
I will call the police on a number I find myself

cam.label: "Stay on camera"
cam.lens: They keep you on the line so you cannot check.
cam.why: Isolation is the core of this scam.

move.label: Move coins to "prove innocence"
move.lens: No court asks you to move coins.
move.why: The coins go to the scammer.

secret.label: "Tell nobody"
secret.lens: Secrecy stops others from warning you.
secret.why: Real cases never forbid you from talking to a lawyer or family.

arrest.label: Threat of a warrant
arrest.lens: A threat to make you obey.

crime.label: A sudden accusation
crime.why: Real cases start with paperwork, not a video call.

actions.label: Hang up and call the police myself

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The "investigator" moved on to someone else.

verify.line: The real police said no case works like this, and thanked you for reporting. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The coins went to the "court wallet". The caller vanished.

what_if.go_ahead: No court asks anyone to move coins. Asking "why" was the way out.
what_if.verify: Calling the police yourself was the safest move.

golden_rule: A real investigation never needs you to stay on camera, keep a secret, or move coins.

quick_check.q: A caller says to stay on camera, tell nobody, and move your coins to prove your innocence. What do you do?

options.text: Hang up and report it. No real case works like this

quick_check.explain: Staying on a call, secrecy and moving coins are the signs of an arrest scam.

hints.nudge: What does a real court ever ask you to move?

rows.v: Police never start with a surprise video call
Hang up and call the police yourself

rows.k: Police ask you to move coins
A threat if you hang up
